cohort: 1,864 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants from the 'Emilia-Romagna Perinatal Network' Registry from 2004 to 2009
finding: Lower gestational age, exclusive formula feeding, higher CRIB II score, maternal hypertension, cesarean delivery, SGA and PDA predicted delayed time to full enteral feeding in VLBW infants.
mod_finding: Newborns delivered via cesarean section had a delayed time to full enteral feeding compared to those born vaginally.
